answer_as_filed: In 2025, the organization operated five health centers and one dental center, incurring $11.3M in operating expenses such as rent, utilities, supplies and salaries. Profits from the 340B savings program were used for operating expenses not covered by grants and revenue from patients.  Patient service revenue and grant funding covered 81.1% of the organization’s expenses.  The 340B savings program helps the organization supplement revenue to cover necessary expenses in providing medical, dental and behavioral health care for our patients.
We did not pay any contract pharmacy directly.
